parameters.notes: ClearQ, a five-band equaliser. Its write block is per band: 8 bytes = band 0-4, frequency u16 (Hz as the panel shows it: 30, 200, 1000, 5k, 15k for raw 30, 200, 1000, 5000, 15000), Q u16 in hundredths (raw 71 shown as 0.71), gain i16, shape u8; one frame sets one band. offset here is the position in the 35-byte read image (band n starts at 7 x n). Mapped = the six controls a sweep took to both ends: band 1 frequency 20-800, band 3 frequency 125-8000, Q of bands 2 and 3 50-1800, gain of bands 2 and 3 -2400..1200. The gain scale 0.01 is inferred (one wheel notch = 100, the panel showed 0.0 at raw 0 and its graph spans +/-20 dB); the displayed end values were not captured. Not mapped, written back unchanged: frequency of bands 2, 4, 5 (only one notch seen: 200->300, 5000->6000, 15000->16000), Q of band 4 (71->121), gain of bands 1, 4, 5 (0->100), Q of bands 1 and 5 (the panel draws no Q knob for their shapes) and the shape byte (defaults 0, 2, 2, 2, 1; the Zen Go owner's band 1 read 4; never seen changing: the panel's shape buttons need a click, the probe only wheeled). The sweep hit the band 3 frequency knob three times and never bands 2, 4, 5. Fields appended after Band 3 Gain (B1 Gain, B1 Shape, B2 Freq, B4 Freq, B4 Q, B4 Gain, B5 Freq, B5 Gain, B5 Shape): ported from the Zen Go, not captured on this device. They were mapped from vendor-panel captures on the owner's Zen Go (same effect type and block); the value meanings below are copied from the Zen Go note: B1 Shape: 0 = low shelf, 4 = low cut; B5 Shape: 1 = high shelf, 3 = high cut; bands 2-4 are bells (shape 2, fixed). The Q knobs of bands 1 and 5 sent nothing in either shape. In a cut state the panel greys the gain and sends gain 0. Panel display: Q = raw / 100, gain = raw / 100 dB, frequency = raw Hz. Discrete 4 live trial 2026-11-22: loaded alone into the channel 3 rack through this project, every control moved by one step and put back, each write confirmed by readback.

parameters.notes: Same effect, type id and per-band block as on the Discrete 4 (its discrete_4_a270.json implementation holds the control evidence and the notes on what is not mapped). On this device the vendor load of ClearQ sent the same five default band frames, to instance 1 because the owner's ClearQ held instance 0 (d5 0a 01 01 <band> ...). Added from the second panel run of 2026-11-21 on the Zen Go: B1 Gain, B1 Shape, B2 Freq, B4 Freq, B4 Q, B4 Gain, B5 Freq, B5 Gain, B5 Shape. Each was moved over its whole range in the vendor panel (wheel, drag or menu), changed only its own bytes and was put back. B1 Shape: 0 = low shelf, 4 = low cut; B5 Shape: 1 = high shelf, 3 = high cut; bands 2-4 are bells (shape 2, fixed). The Q knobs of bands 1 and 5 sent nothing in either shape. In a cut state the panel greys the gain and sends gain 0. Panel display: Q = raw / 100, gain = raw / 100 dB, frequency = raw Hz (fourth run 2026-11-22, zen_click4/, pictures compared with the frames). Probed on a second instance in the channel 3 rack, because the first is in an owner rack; later changed and restored on the first instance through this project (2026-11-21).
